secrets.name: The Bathing Hut
secrets.text: Inside the hut it is dry and smells of creosote and old paperbacks. A deckchair faces a little window onto the sea, and on the shelf is every book anyone has ever left on a beach.

meta.label: The Beach
meta.blurb: The doors at the end of the reading room are open, and there is a beach outside. The sea is grey and very calm, and the bookcases go on out into it.
